Small worked calculations are allowed to learn a concept, clearly labelled learning examples.
Save result.json with the six runtime fields plus the requested fields. Use summary as a STRING.
Do not spend your entire budget retrieving; save useful partial understanding if needed.

Keep the source schema and materials schema from the original result; add source_kind, content_access, domain_relation, relevance_reason and exact supporting_quote. Preserve useful existing sources. If access remains unavailable, report the concrete gap; do not relabel metadata as original text.
